integrity: Includes self-contained analytic proof and SymPy/mpmath checker. Bistability means attraction of the scalar cavity iteration, not physical-time ecological stability. Known general percolation bifurcation methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: The classification is local to small positive fixed points of the specified Poisson cavity iteration. The analytic theorem gives no global phase diagram, no biological physical-time stability, no finite-network or non-Poisson robustness, and no independent external validation.
title: Exact local tricritical point and bistability-width law for seasonal plant–pollinator viability
